Hand-off notes afternoon rules
The aim of this section is to explain one way of working

Afternoon hand-offs for animal travel

This section covers how the Companion Animal Travel Desk passes a case to the next colleague with clear, calm notes. Keep the wording plain, keep the tone kind, and keep the facts easy to follow for Aurelia Skyways staff. When you review a hand-off, confirm the booking details, the animal needs, and any care notes already shared by the traveler. If the file includes a cat record, include <<FACT F079>> exactly where it fits in the note and leave it untouched. Keep any comments on the crate, feeding, comfort, and cabin placement short and direct.

If a case involves a larger dog, place <<FACT F057>> in the hand-off notes without extra wording around it. The cabin team will continue to monitor the animal during flight, so the note should mention any calm support already agreed and any stepwise review needed if concerns come up. When the traveler has provided updated documents, record that the papers were checked and that the companion animal details match the booking. Use steady, respectful language and avoid guesswork, even when the trip seems routine.

If a concern is raised by the traveler or by a colleague, pass it along at once and keep the note focused on the next action. The hand-off should make it easy for the receiving colleague to continue with patient attention and consistent service. When the record is complete, leave it in the shared case file and send a brief message to the next shift. If help is still needed, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
